problems.reason: Sentences 22 and 23 give conflicting age ranges for Tuojiangosaurus: 22 cites the Oxfordian stage (~160 Ma, Late Jurassic), while 23 cites the Bathonian–Callovian stages (168.2–161.5 Ma, Middle Jurassic).

notes: - contradiction: "Tuojiangosaurus lived at the end of the Jurassic Period, approximately 160 million years ago during the Oxfordian stage." / "Tuojiangosaurus lived during the Bathonian to Callovian stages, approximately 168.2 to 161.5 million years ago.": Sentences 22 and 23 give conflicting age ranges for Tuojiangosaurus: 22 cites the Oxfordian stage (~160 Ma, Late Jurassic), while 23 cites the Bathonian–Callovian stages (168.2–161.5 Ma, Middle Jurassic).
